title: craftable mulch in agritech evolved
description: it's a datapack that changes the recipe for mulch in the mod "Agritech-evolved" to be actually possible to craft.
body: essentially, in the mod "agritech evolved" there's item named mulch which is required for progression, but the morons behind it decided to make "farmland" apart of the recipe, instead of yk, DIRT? which would of been a much better option, **_especially since farmland is by no means craftable._**
